title: AI Governance for Institutional Readiness in Finance
abstract: arXiv:2608.02311v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic AI is gaining acceptance in asset management, but governance has not kept pace: 88\% of surveyed finance professionals report no operational governance framework for agentic AI, and only 24 of 75 large U.S. money managers disclosing AI use in Form ADV filings report a formal governance policy. We argue this gap is architectural: governance built for static validation does not survive continuously retrained agentic policies. We propose a four-layer framework (Policy, Engineering, Composition, Systemic) grounded in two distinct kinds of evidence, kept explicitly separate: two calibrated synthetic illustrations (a regret-covariance drift monitor; a crowding simulation showing joint drawdown risk rising from 39.2\% to 79.3\%), and three real, documented cases (a deployed LLM-embedding trading strategy, a \$45 billion discretionary fund's forced-deleveraging blowup, and a tribunal ruling holding an airline liable for its chatbot).

translated_title: 面向金融机构准备度的AI治理
translated_abstract: 智能体AI在资产管理领域日益获得认可，但治理未能跟上步伐：88%的受访金融专业人士表示没有针对智能体AI的运营治理框架，而在75家在Form ADV备案文件中披露AI使用情况的大型美国资产管理公司中，仅有24家报告拥有正式的治理政策。我们认为这一差距是架构性的：为静态验证而构建的治理无法适用于持续再训练的智能体策略。我们提出了一个四层框架（政策层、工程层、组合层、系统层），该框架基于两种明确分离的不同证据：两个经过校准的合成示例（一个遗憾-协方差漂移监测器；一个拥挤度模拟，显示联合回撤风险从39.2%上升到79.3%），以及三个真实且有记录的案例（一个部署了LLM嵌入的交易策略、一个450亿美元自主决策基金的被迫去杠杆崩溃事件，以及一项裁定航空公司对其聊天机器人负责的法庭裁决）。
tldr: 该论文针对金融领域智能体AI治理滞后的架构性差距，提出了一个由合成模拟与真实案例证据支撑的四层治理框架（政策、工程、组合、系统层），使治理体系能够适应持续再训练的智能体策略。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a four-layer governance framework (Policy, Engineering, Composition, Systemic) for agentic AI in finance, grounded in calibrated synthetic illustrations and three documented real-world cases, to address the architectural gap where governance built for static validation fails to handle continuously retrained agentic policies.
